title: Disappointed with Apple Fitness App Data Inconsistencies
body:
I have been a loyal user of the Apple Fitness app for a long time, but recently I’ve encountered a very frustrating issue. Initially, my workout data is recorded correctly — steps, distance, and activity rings all show accurately. I even get the satisfying notification that I’ve closed my rings for the day.

However, after one or two days, I notice that the recorded data changes without any clear reason. The number of steps and distance completed decreases, and as a result, the activity rings that were once closed now show as incomplete.

This inconsistency is extremely discouraging, especially for users like me who are motivated by daily progress and streaks. It undermines trust in the platform, and it’s disappointing to see hard-earned achievements being erased retroactively.

I hope Apple can address this bug soon, as it seriously affects the user experience and motivation for staying active.
author: Quang Nhật Nickname

title: Fitness needs improvement
body:
Dear App Fitness Team, I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to share my experience with the App Fitness application. While I appreciate the concept and features, I have encountered a couple of issues that hinder my overall satisfaction: Slow Updates: The app’s update process seems sluggish. It takes longer than expected to sync data or retrieve new content. As a user, I value efficiency, and this delay affects my motivation to use the app consistently. Incorrect Updates: Occasionally, the app provides inaccurate information or displays outdated data. For a fitness app, accuracy is crucial, especially when tracking progress or setting goals. I recommend addressing this promptly. I believe that addressing these issues will significantly enhance the user experience. As someone who values fitness and wellness, I look forward to seeing improvements in future updates. Thank you for your attention to user feedback. If you have any questions or need further details, feel free to reach out.
